Metadata.title: Klik Go — Delivered to your door, wherever you are
Metadata.description: Food and essentials from your neighborhood stores, delivered by riders from your barangay.

Home.tagline: Delivered to your door, wherever you are.
Home.intro: Order from the karinderias, milk tea shops and stores you already love, delivered by riders who know your barangay.
Home.status: Launching soon in our pilot zone

speed.title: Fast
speed.body: Short distances, local riders, hot food.

reliability.title: Reliable
reliability.body: Clear prices before you order and live tracking after.

community.title: Community
community.body: Lower fees for local merchants, fair pay for local riders.

Home.footer: Klik Go · Made in the Philippines
